newsitem.title: DUBAI: Trade subdued in UAE shares, index slightly up.
newsitem.headline: Trade subdued in UAE shares, index slightly up.

text.p: Trade on the unofficial United Arab Emirates stock market was subdued in the week to Thursday with the index gaining a mere 2.47 points, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) index rose to 2,492.38 points from 2,489.91.
Six shares were up, four down and 16 steady this week.

Most banking shares were stable but NBAD rose 10 dirhams to 490, Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank, which announced its first dividend since its formation, fell five dirhams to 355 and Dubai Islamic Bank was down 23 dirhams at 165.
Market leader Etisalat, the UAE's telecommunications company, gained five dirhams to 940.
